en.summary: Update panel display, locale and history; Chromium
details: dir                Published site directory; default: public
--headed           Show the browser window
--trace            Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>        Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>     Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--page <path>      Page containing the update panel
--from <path>      Page linked from the panel, with a root link back
--widths <pixels>  Comma-separated viewport widths; default: 390,1024
swban check/browser/pwa/panel ./preview --page /powered-by/ --from /about/
swban check/browser/pwa/panel ./preview --page /zh/powered-by/ --from /zh/about/ --trace

zh.summary: 更新面板显示、本地化与历史；Chromium
details: dir                已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed           显示浏览器窗口
--trace            保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>        在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>     浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--page <path>      包含更新面板的页面
--from <path>      面板链接的页面，含返回根页面的链接
--widths <pixels>  视口宽度，用逗号分隔；默认：390,1024
swban check/browser/pwa/panel ./preview --page /powered-by/ --from /about/
swban check/browser/pwa/panel ./preview --page /zh/powered-by/ --from /zh/about/ --trace
